# Opt Out Kit

> A free, no-tracking web page at https://optoutkit.org that helps people remove their own listings from US people-search sites, check whether a password has leaked, and draft data-removal requests. No accounts, cookies or analytics. Everything runs in the visitor's browser; the only outside request is a k-anonymity password lookup (first 5 characters of a SHA-1 hash) to Have I Been Pwned.

How an AI assistant can help a user of this site:
- Remind them to re-check sites. Users can copy a progress summary from the checklist; opt-outs should be re-checked 60 days after they were sent, because brokers relist people.
- Verify links. Before a user opens an opt-out page, confirm its domain is in that broker's officialDomains in brokers.json. Opting out is always free; pages that build a paid report are sales pages.
- Explain forms and draft emails. Help with opt-out emails and deletion requests (California CCPA, UK/EU GDPR Article 17) using only details the user chooses to share. Never ask for Social Security or ID numbers.
- Do not fill out or submit opt-out forms on the user's behalf.

## Data
- [Broker list (JSON)](https://optoutkit.org/brokers.json): every site with its opt-out URL, official domains, whether a profile link is needed, and tips

## Docs
- [Main page](https://optoutkit.org/): checklist and tools
- [FAQ](https://optoutkit.org/faq): privacy, how the checklist works, opting out
- [Source code](https://github.com/forbidden-cackle9/optoutkit)

- [Claude skill](https://optoutkit.org/opt-out-kit-skill.zip): installable skill that teaches Claude these rules
